shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/test-commands.yml
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log --oneline -5
git diff origin/main --stat
git diff origin/main -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '90,155p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,100p'
sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface PromptBuilderConfig|type PromptBuilderConfig|class PromptBuilder|new PromptBuilder\\(\" src | head -80
sed -n '1,180p' src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
rg -n \"beforeSession.*throws|baseSystemPrompt|new PromptBuilder\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -100
rg -n \"reanchor|spec anchor|@spec|spec:\" scripts .lore package.json jest.config.*"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts::ChatOrchestrator hooks beforeSession runs onError then afterSession when it throws, and still rejects to the caller'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
if [ -e scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo 'NO_REANCHOR_SCRIPT'; fi
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '108,145p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '28,72p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|spec anchor|specAnchor|validated by\" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts .lore src | head -120
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '20,35p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "docs: describe before-session hook failures" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch
git log --oneline -3'
